items.title: 冷鋒今日稍後橫過廣東沿岸 天文台預料本港今晚氣溫下降
items.summary: 天文台發出特別天氣提示，表示華南北部的一道冷鋒逐漸向南移動，預料今日稍後橫過廣東沿岸。本港會有一兩陣雨，晚上氣溫下降。隨後一兩日顯著轉涼，星期五及星期六市區最低氣溫在15、16度左右，新界再低兩三度。 天文台又說，受到強烈東北季候風影響，星期五及星期六初時高地風寒效應會較為明顯及寒冷，提醒市民、特別是戶外活動的人士，要留意天氣變化，注意保暖，並關顧長者及慢性病患者。 編輯：盧曉珊
items.titleEn: The weather forecast for Hong Kong tonight is that the cold weather will continue to cool over the coast of Guangdong.
items.summaryEn: A special weather advisory issued by the Astronomical Station indicates that a frost in north-south China is moving southward and is expected to cross the coast of Guangdong later today. In Hong Kong, it will rain for a couple of days and the temperature will drop at night. After a couple of days of cooling, the lowest temperatures in the city on Friday and Saturday were around 15 or 16 degrees Celsius, and the new limit dropped by two to three degrees Celsius. The meteorological station also said that the effects of the strong northeastern climatic winds on Friday and early Saturday will be more pronounced and cold, warning citizens, especially those who are outdoors, to be aware of climate change, pay attention to warming and care for the elderly and people with chronic illnesses. Editor: Luciushan

items.title: 屈臣氏：第三方供應商網絡安全事件無關香港業務 不涉個人資料
items.summary: 屈臣氏集團表示，已知悉涉及第三方供應商的網絡安全事件，指該供應商為集團旗下數個歐洲業務的網站提供搜尋功能，強調該供應商從未獲授權存取任何集團業務的客戶資料，事件亦不涉及任何個人資料外洩。 屈臣氏集團發言人回應查詢時表示，事件不涉及香港及亞洲業務，亦沒有任何個人資料外洩，因此未有通報個人資料私隱專員公署。…
items.titleEn: Dr. Dukan: The cybersecurity incident involving third-party providers has nothing to do with Hong Kong's business, no personal information
items.summaryEn: The Dresden Group said it was aware of cybersecurity incidents involving third-party providers that provided search functionality for the websites of several of the Group's European businesses, stressing that the provider had never been authorized to access customer data from any of the Group operations and that the incident did not involve any personal data breaches. In response to the inquiry, a spokesman for the Dresden Group said that the incident did not involve Hong Kong and Asian business, and that there was no personal data leak, so no personal data privacy expert was notified. items.title: 元朗官立小學重考小六呈分試 校長稱嚴肅跟進並優化評估機制
items.summary: 有報道指，元朗官立小學小六升中呈分試，中文科閱讀卷涉嫌重用舊試卷篇章。校方表示將安排重考。 校長余慶賢回應本台查詢時表示，獲悉事件後已即時啟動既定機制進行調查，並正嚴肅跟進，為維護考試的公平和公正性，經審慎考慮和評估後，決定安排全體六年級學生重考中文科閱讀卷。 她表示，會全面檢視及優化校本評估機制，以避免同類事件再次發生。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: The school has been reviewing six grades for the first time in its history, with the principal calling it a serious follow-up and optimization of the assessment mechanism.
items.summaryEn: According to reports, the Chinese language textbooks are presumed to have reused old test chapters in the six-liter primary school. The school said it would re-schedule the exam. In response to the inquiry, the school's principal, Yu Qingsheng, said that he had immediately started investigating the established mechanisms after learning about the incident and was following seriously the decision to arrange for a re-examination of Chinese literature reading books for all sixth graders after careful consideration and evaluation to preserve the fairness and impartiality of the exams. She said that a comprehensive review and optimization of the school's assessment mechanism would be undertaken to prevent similar incidents from happening again. Editor's note: This is the last post.

items.title: 警方拘捕一名女子涉嫌售賣BIGBANG尾場「黃牛票」
items.summary: 韓國男團BIGBANG在啟德主場館舉行四場演唱會，今晚最後一場。警方拘捕一名涉嫌售賣「黃牛票」的女子。 警方在社交平台表示，今日在啟德體育園一帶展開連串打擊「黃牛票」行動，一名便衣警員拘捕一名涉嫌以高於門票面值的價格兜售當晚演唱會兩張門票的女子，而主辦方在接報後已將涉案門票作廢處理。 警方強調，會持續加強執法行動打擊「黃牛票」活動，並呼籲市民透過正規渠道購票，避免助長炒作行為或因購買無效門票而遭受損失。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: Police arrested a woman suspected of selling "yellow cow tickets" at the Big Bang stand
items.summaryEn: South Korean boy band Big Bang will hold four concerts at the White House, the last of which will be tonight. Police arrested a woman who was allegedly selling "yellow cow tickets". Police said on social media that today, in the wake of a series of "yellow cow ticket" attacks at the Ehud Stadium, a white-collared policeman arrested a woman who allegedly sold two tickets for a night of concerts for more than the price of the ticket, and the organizers had already cancelled the tickets after receiving the news. Police stressed that they will continue to step up law enforcement actions against the "Yellow Bulls" campaign, and called on citizens to buy tickets through regular channels to avoid encouraging fraud or losing money by buying invalid tickets. Editor's note: This is the last post.

items.summaryEn: The Fisheries and Wildlife Service has filed a complaint against a local captain and five inland fishermen for allegedly using snake cages to catch fish on a local vessel in waters near the Sahara. Six people have been charged with violating the Shark Fisheries Protection Act and the case will be heard tomorrow at the Trial Court in Penang. At around 8:00 p.m. last night, while investigating a local vessel allegedly using snake cages to fish in the waters, the Fisheries Authority picked up a batch of crustaceans from the vessel. items.titleEn: Election Secretariat holds training and exercises on the general elections of the Election Commission
items.summaryEn: The General Election of 2026 will be held on 22nd of this month. The Election Bureau has held a series of training and simulation exercises to help elected officials in different positions, to strengthen their understanding and resilience to the work involved. The President of the Election Management Committee, Rudy Akbar, and Commissioner Stanley, today visited the Election Bureau to work out on the ground the arrangements for polling stations staff. It is a secondary training for relevant election staff designed to deepen their knowledge of how polling stations operate and how to issue ballots, including the expertise to issue ballot papers using an electronic voter registration system, and to inform the voting process when it is necessary to provide a backup model.
